map.最小 A = 15 − 0.25×年龄；平均 A = 18.5 − 0.30×年: Minimum A = 15 − 0.25×age; average A = 18.5 − 0.30×age; maximum A = 25 − 0.40×age (Hofstetter)
map.Hofstetter 经验公式按年龄估算调节幅度区间，近点距离 = 100 /: The Hofstetter empirical formula estimates the amplitude of accommodation range by age, and the near point distance = 100 / amplitude of accommodation (cm), used to assess presbyopia and accommodative insufficiency.
map.近点距离(cm) = 100 / 调节幅度(D)（正视眼）: Near point distance (cm) = 100 / amplitude of accommodation (D) (emmetropic eye)
map.调节幅度低于最小值提示调节不足，可能引起视疲劳、近视力下降，需排查老视或调节功能: An amplitude of accommodation below the minimum indicates accommodative insufficiency, which may cause eye strain and reduced near vision, requiring screening for presbyopia or accommodative dysfunction.
map.Hofstetter公式为人群统计经验值，个体差异较大。调节幅度检测推荐移近法/: The Hofstetter formula is a population statistical empirical value with considerable individual variation. For measuring the amplitude of accommodation, the push-up/negative lens method is recommended; results are for reference.
map.由远点、近点算调节幅度（单位 D）。: Compute the amplitude of accommodation (in D) from the far and near points.
map.按年龄对照 Hofstetter 公式看是否早衰。: Compare with the Hofstetter formula by age to see whether it is prematurely declining.
map.老花配镜估附加度。: Estimate the addition for presbyopia eyewear.
map.远点 50cm(2D)、近点 10cm(10D) → 调节幅度 A=1/近点−1: Far point 50 cm (2D), near point 10 cm (10D) → amplitude of accommodation A=1/near point − 1/far point=10−2=8.00D.
map.30 岁 Hofstetter 均值≈8.5D、最小≈4.5D；实测 8D 正常: At 30 the Hofstetter average ≈8.5D, minimum ≈4.5D; a measured 8D is normal. At 50 the average ≈2.5D, and below this a presbyopic addition is needed.
map.调节幅度怎么测？: How is the amplitude of accommodation measured?
map.推近视标到模糊（近点），记录距离；A=1/近点(m)−1/远点(m)，远点无穷远: Move the near target until blurred (near point) and record the distance; A=1/near point (m) − 1/far point (m), and when the far point is infinity it is 1/near point.
map.老花和调节幅度关系？: Relationship between presbyopia and amplitude of accommodation?
map.老花即调节幅度随龄下降，附加=习惯阅读距离需求−剩余幅度，通常近用 40cm 需: Presbyopia is the age-related decline in the amplitude of accommodation; the addition = the habitual reading distance demand − the remaining amplitude, and near use at 40 cm usually needs 2.5D.
